classification.difficultyReason: Group raw measurements using two specified class widths and construct histograms.

inlines.text: In a medical test, a group of students had the distance from hip to heel measured. The measurements were made correct to the nearest centimetre. The results were as follows.
Present this information in a histogram using the classes:

answer.short: Histogram with frequencies $3,18,5$ for the classes $70–79,80–89,90–99$, respectively.
answer.worked: Counting the measurements in each class gives $3$ in $70–79$, $18$ in $80–89$ and $5$ in $90–99$. The frequencies total $26$. Draw touching columns of equal width, with frequency on the vertical axis and length in centimetres on the horizontal axis.

spec.description: Complete histogram using the textbook's lower-class-limit axis convention.

answer.short: Histogram with frequencies $1,2,8,10,5$ for the five classes in order.
answer.worked: Counting in the narrower classes gives $1,2,8,10,5$. These total $26$. Draw five touching columns of width $5$, with these frequencies as their heights.

spec.description: Complete histogram using the textbook's lower-class-limit axis convention.
